column5: def TreeCircuit.balanced (b : Bool) (cs : List (TreeCircuit n)) : TreeCircuit n
theorem TreeCircuit.balanced_eval (b : Bool) (cs : List (TreeCircuit n)) (x : Fin n → Bool) : (TreeCircuit.balanced b cs).eval x = (TreeCircuit.node b cs).eval x
theorem TreeCircuit.balanced_nil (b : Bool) : TreeCircuit.balanced b ([] : List (TreeCircuit n)) = TreeCircuit.node b []
theorem TreeCircuit.balanced_singleton (b : Bool) (c : TreeCircuit n) : TreeCircuit.balanced b [c] = c
theorem TreeCircuit.depth_balanced_le (b : Bool) (cs : List (TreeCircuit n)) : (TreeCircuit.balanced b cs).depth ≤ TreeCircuit.maxDepth cs + Nat.clog 2 cs.length + 1
theorem TreeCircuit.maxFanin_balanced_le (b : Bool) (cs : List (TreeCircuit n)) : (TreeCircuit.balanced b cs).maxFanin ≤ max 2 (TreeCircuit.maxFaninL cs)
theorem TreeCircuit.size_balanced_le (b : Bool) (cs : List (TreeCircuit n)) : (TreeCircuit.balanced b cs).size ≤ TreeCircuit.sumSize cs + cs.length + 1
